title: rosa bella var. mongolica
intro: Rosa bella var. mongolica, commonly known as the Mongolian rose, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Rosa bella var. mongolica include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and immune system enhancement. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
